Our Commitment ‍ Dig International Inc. ("Dig", "we," “our,” or "us") is committed to ensuring that our digital services are accessible to people with disabilities. We strive to continuously improve the user experience for all visitors and to meet recognized accessibility standards. To fulfill this, we have undertaken a process to optimize our website to align with the criteria of the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.1 (WCAG 2.1) at the AA level. This statement applies to our websites located at https://dig.ai/ and https://ask.dig.ai/ and the services provided through them. 2. Services Overview We provide social media research and analysis services that enable businesses and individuals to understand the social media narrative surrounding their brand, products, and industry. Our services are provided through web-based platforms accessible via standard web browsers. 3. Accessibility Features We have made technical and design measures to support perceivable, operable, understandable and robust digital content and interactions. To enhance accessibility, our site includes (or supports) features such as: a. Our website uses clear, structured headings and text for better screen reader navigation. b. Keyboard navigation throughout core content and controls. c. Ability to resize text (up to 200%) without loss of content or functionality. d. Options to adjust color contrast (including dark mode/light mode, high contrast, monochrome). e. Ability to change cursor size and color, font style, alignment, and link/heading highlighting. f. Ensuring interactive elements (buttons, links, form fields) have a visible focus indicator and clear hover/focus states. g. Avoiding reliance solely on sensory characteristics (such as color alone) to convey meaning. h. Use of valid semantic markup (HTML) and ARIA attributes to enable screen-reader and assistive-technology compatibility. 4. Maintenance and Monitoring of Accessibility Despite our very best efforts to allow anybody to adjust the website to their needs, there may still be pages or sections that are not fully accessible, are in the process of becoming accessible, or are lacking an adequate technological solution to make them accessible. We are continually improving our accessibility, adding, updating, improving its options and features, and developing and adopting new technologies. All this is meant to reach the optimal level of accessibility. Please contact us if you encounter with an accessibility issue. 5. Browser and Assistive Technology Compatibility Our objective is to support as many modern web browsers and assistive technologies as possible, so our users can choose the best fitting tools for them, with as few limitations as possible. We therefore aim to support all major systems including: Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari and build content that is usable with leading screen-reader tools on both Windows and macOS. When using mobile devices or different platforms, please be aware that accessibility features and performance may vary depending on the version of the platform, the device in use and whether features are supported in the app or mobile browser environment. Below are links to common operating system accessibility resources: • Apple Devices • Android Devices • Chrome Browser • Firefox Browser • Edge Browser 6. Third-Party Content Where portions of our site use third-party components that are outside our direct control, there may be accessibility limitations beyond our immediate ability to remedy. 7. Feedback & Reporting We welcome your input on how we might improve accessibility. If you encounter any barrier, accessibility-related bug, need our support, or have a suggestion, please contact our accessibility officer at: accessibility@dig.ai We will endeavor to respond to requests promptly, review and monitor issues and where feasible make corrections. If you are not satisfied with our response to your accessibility feedback, you may be entitled under applicable national or EU law to contact the relevant enforcement or conciliation body in your country.
